headline: Time is of the essence
dek: The President criticises the judge who delayed by two more weeks the reconstruction of the golf course he calls “Trash Island”, in Washington, and announces an appeal. Switzerland has reviewed the request.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Biden appointed Judge Reyes has delayed, for yet another two weeks, the fix up and reconstruction, by the Department of the Interior, of one of the worst and most dangerous golf courses anywhere in the U.S. “Trash Island,” as it is affectionately known, needs work, and needs it now! It is in a terrible state of disrepair, as anybody can see by just looking at the pictures that are now circulating all over the Country, and in the Court. They don’t call it Trash Island for no reason! Why would a judge want to delay taking a terrible and very unsafe golf course, one that is mocked all over D.C.(and far beyond!), instead of quickly turning it into a great and admired one? “INTERIOR” has the absolute right to do so, and will immediately appeal, on an expedited basis, this highly destructive and political decision of the judge. Time is of the essence, or golf seasons, jobs, prestige, and much money, will be lost! Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DJT
original.key: Time is of the essence, or golf seasons, jobs, prestige, and much money, will be lost!
original.context: Posted on 15 November 2026. The descriptions of the golf course, the court case and the judge are the President’s.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 15 November 2026 (shown as 11/15/26, 6:30 AM Pacific).

en: Switzerland notes that the golf course will wait two more weeks.
Here, a public consultation usually lasts three months. Two weeks is barely time to find the envelope.
The golf course will still be there. Golf courses are very patient.
